heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 92–181, title V, § 5.26(a), Dec. 10, 1971, 85 Stat. 624

notes.text: Section 639, act June 16, 1933, ch. 98, title VIII, § 82, 48 Stat. 273, made a supplementary grant of powers to Governor of Farm Credit Administration.
Section 640, act June 16, 1933, ch. 98, title VIII, § 85, 48 Stat. 273, authorized Farm Credit Administration to have a seal. See section 2248 of this title.
